baseline.workingTree: Existing staged and unstaged changes retained; only the two selected guides and this batch ledger/report are modified by this audit.

declaredStatus.claim: The shared/native implementation exists with explicit runtime capabilities. S15 exact-target acceptance is historical; the current changed Profile remains unadmitted. Mobile externals remain none and S16 has independent incomplete exits.
declaredStatus.limits: These are maintained status statements checked for guide consistency, not new runtime/device acceptance.

checks.detail: Current root/package boundaries and desktop text agree on workbench, host recipes, plugin namespaces and source owners.

The renderer port uses generation/revision ordering, awaits initial mirror alignment, retains recoverable data and blocks later writes after native failure. No native implementation change or re-audit.
Opening and detailed account-connection descriptions now agree with backupProxyIds; no proxy connectivity claim is added.

Current authority and exact-target closure are explicit; target architecture/file/channel/mobile extensions do not imply present installation/execution support. Historical live observations keep their original dates and limits.

Two selected guides, six direct neighbor documents and three guide/skill reference files pass 117 local-link checks and one heading anchor. Counterparts are reciprocal and metadata agree. All four source-contract files remain byte-identical, including captureDate.

findings.trigger: Using Shared behavior and storage to locate tags, creation state or source protocol implementations.
findings.effect: The desktop guide assigned all tag/composition state to workbench and protocols to the removed music-sources package, conflicting with the current plugin-owned namespaces and packages.
findings.repair: Synchronize shared workbench/host recipe orchestration, tag/creation plugin ownership and independent source packages in both locales.

findings.trigger: Implementing native/renderer product startup recovery from the maintained guide.
findings.effect: Both locales still selected mirrors by latest timestamp and described failure feedback without the current generation/revision ordering, startup alignment or write barrier.
findings.repair: Describe current complete-generation/revision selection, mirror alignment before repositories, recoverable peer restoration, unsupported/unrecoverable failure handling and stop-after-native-failure writes.
findings.limits: Source-level documentation alignment only; no new storage/runtime acceptance or recovery test was executed.

findings.trigger: Reading the opening account/proxy capability description.
findings.effect: The opening described one proxy and future failover foundations, contradicting the later implemented primary/eight-backup connection description and current public backupProxyIds contract.
findings.repair: State direct or primary plus up to eight ordered unauthenticated backups. Keep unsupported authentication/group UI and native/live evidence limits explicit.

findings.trigger: Interpreting the current-plugin-host/mobile-target sections as present target admission or all-platform installation support.
findings.effect: The guide presented historical S15 acceptance as current, mixed adopted boundaries with future media/file/iOS entry claims and described mobile native work only as future. It did not carry the S15 matrix warning that the changed Profile is unadmitted.
findings.repair: Distinguish historical exact-target evidence, current closed installation/execution pending renewed acceptance, adopted native ownership, current catalog media unavailability, existing Android adapters and inert preview-only mobile policy, and future iOS/acquisition/channel requirements.
findings.limits: No new Profile/OS/WebView/resource admission or B19 device/runtime review; the maintained S15 matrix and root runtime rules are the status authorities.

handoff: B20-ownership-status-scope-repository：基线 0da1709 与本批文件哈希。完成桌面运行端架构指南及中英文对应页的职责、状态和范围核对，四类问题已原位修复：工作台/标签/创作/来源归属过时，快照仍按时间戳恢复，账号首段仍只描述单代理，以及历史 S15 准入、当前能力与未来移动获取入口混写。现按完整代次和 revision 描述恢复与失败写屏障，明确主代理加最多八个有序备份，记录 Profile 改变后的外置关闭状态，区分 Android 已有适配、非执行预览和 iOS/渠道待办。两份指南、六份直接邻接文档和三份指南/技能引用共 117 个本地链接及一个锚点通过；格式与差异检查通过，四份来源契约字节未变。仅文档修改，未复跑产品测试或运行验收。本子批次 conformant/pass-scoped；B20 完成二项、余两项。下一批唯一入口 B20-bilingual-counterparts-indexes-repository，先做结构扫描，只展开具体不一致项。
